variants.headline: Stewardship fails the food test
variants.body: Food supply is insufficient in {colony}, leaving people hungry. Practical provision, rather than confidence alone, is the relevant test of any response. We judge {target} inadequate.

variants.headline: Insufficient supply is an adverse result
variants.body: People in {colony} are hungry: food supply does not meet their needs. An economic assessment must begin with that essential shortfall. We judge {target} inadequate.

variants.headline: Practical failure warrants scrutiny
variants.body: Food is insufficient in {colony}, and residents are hungry. A workable answer must connect its proposals to the practical need for adequate supply. We judge {target} inadequate.
